description: Fetch the top matching community skills for a topic (up to 5, one per repository) and return their rule lines merged into one deduplicated digest, each line tagged with its source skill.

context.description: REQUIRED. What you are actually doing + your stack + constraints. Ranks candidates and fits them to your repo.

query.description: The topic/task to synthesize across skills (e.g. "playwright e2e testing best practices").

name: synthesize_skills
